title: Bridge Web Login Gaps in Agent-Run iOS Acceptance Tests
summary: MarvinInSwift describes an iOS acceptance workflow that stalled when XcodeBuildMCP reached a web-based login it could not manipulate. He added Appium for DOM-aware entry and submission, then returned control to XcodeBuildMCP so the agent could navigate the native target screen, execute the Jira specification, and produce an acceptance report.
takeaway: Model hybrid authentication as an explicit tool handoff: use DOM-aware automation for the web login, then return to simulator-native controls for the app journey and evidence report.
